_meta.purpose: Layer 2 dual-use binary lookup for core.lolbas_lookup
notes: Command strings are intentionally dropped — a LOLBAS match alone is not malicious, it only means the command line deserves review.
Categories and MITRE IDs are the distinct union across every documented abuse command for that binary.
